name: Beatland
desc:
Welcome to "Beatland" by Telekom Electronic Beats, a safe space for diverse communities to experience music culture. 

🌱 New Game: Floating Forest! Embark on an exciting journey – the Obby Jetpack trail with new Islands unlocked each week
🎮 Acquire new free cosmetics! 
🕺 Dance and listen to new music
🧑‍💼 Take jobs with your friends and earn Beatcoins to purchase free items! Complete the Obby in the tower or check out DJ HypeXta’s Mansion
👜 Equip your Avatar with exclusive fashion, art, or accessories
